problem.PERSONAL_WORKSPACE_UNDELETABLE: Your personal workspace can't be deleted. Only workspaces you created can be removed.
problem.PRECONDITION_FAILED: This changed somewhere else since it was loaded. Reload it, then make your changes again.

rejection.FILE_EMPTY: This file has no content. Check the export and upload it again.
rejection.FILE_SIZE_MISMATCH: This file changed while it was uploading. Upload it again.
rejection.FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: This file's content isn't a supported type, whatever its name says. Upload a CSV or ZIP file.
rejection.FILE_CORRUPT: This file is damaged and can't be read. Re-export it and upload the new copy.
rejection.ZIP_ENCRYPTED: This ZIP is password-protected. Remove the password and upload it again.
rejection.ZIP_TOO_MANY_MEMBERS: This ZIP has more files inside it than allowed. Split it into smaller ZIPs.
rejection.ZIP_TOO_LARGE: This ZIP is larger than allowed once unpacked. Split it into smaller ZIPs.
rejection.ZIP_RATIO_EXCEEDED: This ZIP unpacks to far more than its compressed size, so it was refused as unsafe. Upload the original files instead.
rejection.ZIP_NESTED: This ZIP contains another ZIP inside it. Upload the inner files directly, not nested.
rejection.ZIP_UNSAFE_PATH: A file inside this ZIP has an unsafe path. Re-create the ZIP without folders outside it.
rejection.ZIP_SYMLINK: This ZIP contains a shortcut (symbolic link) instead of a real file. Replace it with the actual file and upload again.
rejection.ZIP_MEMBER_UNSUPPORTED: A file inside this ZIP isn't a supported type. Remove it and upload the ZIP again.
